headword: {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}
reading: せいりょういんりょうすい

definitions.explanation: A legal and commercial term for non-alcoholic drinks other than milk and dairy beverages. Includes sodas, juices, sports drinks, tea, and water. Commonly seen on vending machines and product labels in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a soft drink from the vending machine.

examples.japanese: {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{過|す}ぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Drinking too many soft drinks is not good for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ。
examples.english: Summer is a time when soft drink sales increase significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
This is the official regulatory term defined by the Food Sanitation Act ({食品衛生法|しょくひんえいせいほう}). In everyday conversation, people are more likely to say ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧ or ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧. The formal term appears on product labels, in news reports, and in legal/business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ (soft drink manufacturer)
- {清涼飲料水|せいりょういんりょうすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (soft drink market)
